features: Triple-Device Multi-Pairing Connect up to 3 devices simultaneously — 2 via Bluetooth and 1 via the 2.4 GHz receiver — and switch between them instantly.
Dual Wireless Modes (BT + 2.4GHz) Enjoy smooth, lag-free typing with reliable Bluetooth or 2.4 GHz connectivity for PCs, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.
Microsoft Co-pilot Support Dedicated support for AI-powered assistance, making multitasking, productivity, and workflow navigation faster.
Full Multimedia Hotkeys Equipped with function shortcut keys for volume, playback, brightness, screenshots, and quick-access controls.
Rechargeable Battery Built-In No more replacing batteries — comes with an in-built rechargeable battery for long-lasting wireless performance.
Smart Power Saving Mode Auto standby conserves power when not in use, giving you extended battery backup throughout the day.
Wide Device Compatibility Works seamlessly with Windows PCs, laptops, tablets, and smartphones, making it perfect for home, office, or hybrid work setups.
